mapper.select: SELECT table_name AS tableName, table_comment AS tableComment, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() ORDER BY table_name ASC

SELECT column_name AS columnName, data_type AS dataType, column_type AS columnType, column_comment AS columnComment, is_nullable AS isNullable, column_key AS columnKey, extra AS extra FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = #{tableName} ORDER BY ordinal_position ASC
